f.title: Apply Brazilian law to transfers of data processed or collected in Brazil, wherever the parties are
f.statement: An international transfer must comply with the LGPD and this Regulation when (I) the processing is carried out in Brazil (subject to LGPD Art. 4(IV) and Article 8 of the Regulation); (II) the processing aims to offer goods or services to, or process data of, individuals in Brazil; or (III) the personal data were collected in Brazil. f.title: Transfer only for legitimate, specific, informed purposes, with an LGPD legal basis and a valid transfer mechanism

b) standard contractual clauses, binding corporate rules or specific contractual clauses, in the form of this Regulation; or
c) in the cases provided for in items II, "d", and III to IX of art. 33 of Law No. 13.709 of 14 August 2018.
